attributes.action: Protect existing refugees from retrospective settlement rule changes
attributes.additional_details: The Government indicated that people who claimed asylum before 2 March 2026 could keep the five-year settlement route under transitional arrangements. However, the Home Office now says they “will move to core protection”, potentially facing a 10–30-year qualifying period. Refugees already granted status under the previous rules should be allowed to complete the five-year route. New rules should apply to future applicants, not retrospectively to existing refugees.
attributes.background: Protect existing refugees from retrospective settlement changes. Honour the five-year route for people already granted refugee status under the previous rules. Apply the new settlement system to future asylum applicants, not existing refugees.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Protect existing refugees from retrospective settlement rule changes" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786148
